title: Scalar Curvature Question [?12]: Q-Non-Essentiality of Manifolds with Sc > 0
exact_target: Let $X$ be a closed oriented Riemannian manifold of strictly positive scalar curvature, and let $\Gamma$ be a discrete group. For every continuous map $f:X\to B\Gamma$, must $f_*[X]=0$ in $H_{\dim X}(B\Gamma;\mathbb Q)$? The classifying space $B\Gamma$ has fundamental group $\Gamma$ and contractible universal cover. The assertion concerns rational homology and includes both spin and nonspin manifolds.
